run_copy_labels: run the script to prepend zero-padded utterance IDs to each line read from stdin
summarize_copy_labels: summarize the copy_labels script that renames label lines with sequential utterance identifiers
review_copy_labels: review the copy_labels script that reads stdin and outputs indexed utterance labels
test_copy_labels: test the copy_labels script by piping label lines through stdin and verifying indexed output
build_copy_labels_pipeline: build a pipeline that pipes label files through copy_labels to generate indexed utterance names
